Several '''droids''' of an unknown model were used as '''[[Lantern/Legends|lanterns]]''' to illuminate [[Rish Loo/Legends|Rish Loo's]] [[Rish Loo's laboratory/Legends|secret laboratory]] on [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]]. The droids levitated above the ground using [[Repulsorlift/Legends|repulsorlifts]], and also had the capacity to walk using short appendages on their underside.<ref name="Shadow Warrior" />

==History==
Around the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]], during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], several of these droids were present when [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] was taken prisoner by Count Dooku and his [[IG-100 MagnaGuard/Legends|MagnaGuards]]. They also participated in the duel between the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] and the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] [[Sith Lord/Legends|Lord]].<ref name="Shadow Warrior">{{TCW|Shadow Warrior}}</ref> Also, many lantern droids were part of [[Preigo's Traveling World of Wonder/Legends|Preigo's Traveling World of Wonder]] when they went to perform for [[Hondo Ohnaka/Legends|Hondo Ohnaka]] and his group of pirates on [[Florrum/Legends|Florrum]].<ref name="Bound for Rescue" />
